The CAA Micro-RONI Gen 3 is a carbine conversion kit for regular Glock handguns, the Micro-RONI is designed to offer a better grip, stability and platform for many accessories. Use your pistol for a greater effective range, faster aiming and better accuracy.
 The kit has been used on a Glock 18C.

 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] NATO scopes and reflex sights
 %c[ui_gray_2]COMPATIBLE MOD KITS:
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Default: Mercenary mod kit

The CAA Micro-RONI Gen 3 is a carbine conversion kit for regular Glock handguns, the Micro-RONI is designed to offer a better grip, stability and platform for many accessories. Use your pistol for a greater effective range, faster aiming and better accuracy.
 This version of Micro-RONI has been modified by mercenaries to fit their needs in the Zone. Although it`s mainly found among mercs, other experienced loners and monolithians will use them as a trophy.
 The kit has been used on a Glock 18C.
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] GemTech suppressor (after upgrades)
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] LCO Leupold Carbine Optic
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] LAM
